source.publisher: NCA / NECC / OFSI (JMLIT+ Sanctions Facilitators Cell)
source.title: Red Alert: Financial Sanctions Evasion Typologies, Russian Elites and Enablers (0697-NECC)

summary: GOLDEN LABEL, hand-drafted against the PDF. UK red alert on how designated Russian elites and their UK enablers evade financial sanctions: transferring shareholdings to relatives, employees and nominees before or just after designation, diluting stakes below the 50% control threshold, trusts and offshore structures that leave the designated person in indirect control, movement to non-sanctioning jurisdictions, crypto-assets, and thirty-four detection indicators for frozen-asset transfers, enablers and suspicious payments, including open-account third-party trade payments.

citations.quote: Transfer assets such as shareholdings in holding companies to trusted proxies such as relatives or employees

DPs communicating changes to the beneficial ownership of their corporate structures such as Private Investment Companies (PICs) and Joint Stock Companies (JSC) to non-Russian or dual national family members or associates, or nominee directors/shareholders, prior to, or shortly after sanctions taking effect.

Complex ownership structures could include circular ownership structures, shell companies and trust structures, with varying combinations of relatives or other close business associates of DPs operating as PSC, trustee, beneficiary, settlor, protector or other connected person.
Although a DP may claim to have relinquished the asset, it is highly likely that they will retain their influence through trusted proxies and enablers.
These new individuals are likely to be a front, with the DP maintaining indirect control.
A large number of off-the-shelf corporations with no trading record with nominee ownership used as throughputs.

DPs will seek to transfer assets and funds directly and indirectly to jurisdictions where sanctions are not in place, such as the UAE, Turkey, China, Brazil, India and the former Soviet Union (excluding the Baltic States and Ukraine).
it is likely that DPs will explore alternative payment methods, including the use of crypto-assets, to move funds to circumvent sanctions and mitigate reduced access to the SWIFT payment system.
Change in address and names for Russian entities in the lead up to the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
Circumvention attempts through Open Account Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML) typology, such as increases in third party open account payments.
such as increases in third party open account payments.
involving corporations incorporated by the same people and company (often with a registered office at the same physical address).
Material on open source, such as Companies House, indicating work for multiple sanctioned entities, such as multiple directorships.
such as the sale of high value assets, where funds are then disbursed offshore through secrecy jurisdictions.

typologies.label: Enabler-facilitated sanctions evasion by professional services

citations.quote: Enablers are individuals or businesses facilitating sanctions evasion and associated money laundering.
Trust and Company Service Providers (TCSPs) offering nominees and trustee services to DPs and close family members or business associates.

typologies.label: Pre-designation asset transfer exploiting designation timing gaps

citations.quote: differing timescales in designating individuals between jurisdictions created opportunities for DPs to facilitate the movement of funds/assets.
Sell or transfer assets at a loss in order to realise their value before sanctions take effect;

typologies.label: Ownership dilution below the 50% control threshold

citations.quote: Divest investments to ensure ownership stakes are below the 50% threshold, or relinquishing previous controlling stakes.
Beneficial ownership changes to just below aggregated thresholds.

Numerous transfers of shares from sanctioned entities to non-sanctioned entities involving corporations incorporated by the same people and company (often with a registered office at the same physical address).
A large number of off-the-shelf corporations with no trading record with nominee ownership used as throughputs.

actors.name: Designated persons (Russian elites)
actors.role: Sanctioned Russian elites and HNWIs moving personal and commercial holdings before and after designation

citations.quote: some Designated Persons (DPs) are using a range of techniques in order to evade sanctions impacting on their personal and commercial holdings.

actors.name: UK enablers (professional services)
actors.role: Legal, financial, TCSP, estate agent, auction house and family office professionals facilitating evasion; complicit, wilfully blind or unwitting

citations.quote: Key professions include (but are not limited to) legal (barristers and solicitors), financial (relationship managers, accountants, investment advisors, wealth managers, payment processors, private equity, trust and company service providers), estate agents, auction houses, company directors, intermediaries/agents and private family offices.

actors.name: Russian money launderers
actors.role: Professional launderers providing cash to crypto-asset services on behalf of Russian clients

citations.quote: Russian money launderers have increasingly been observed in UK intelligence and operational activity providing cash to crypto-asset services, with the ability to move significant volumes of funds.

extraction_notes: Golden label. Pages 6-9 and 13-15 are threat-response, supervisor and handling boilerplate with no typology content. PAT004 Circular Ownership is mentioned once inside the SAN009 quote and is not labelled separately (convention: indicators are not typologies); PAT005 and PAT001 kept at medium/low for consistency with ADV-2026-0013. SAN006 chosen over TBML010 per the twin convention; TBML008 kept because the alert names third-party open-account payments as the specific technique. Three emergent labels: enabler facilitation, pre-designation timing arbitrage, threshold dilution. Ukraine, US and EU appear as victim or designating parties only and are not jurisdictions.
